title: anoda zuccagnii
intro: Anoda zuccagnii, commonly known as firewheel or firewheel tree, is a plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating fever, reducing inflammation, and treating various infections. The health benefits of Anoda zuccagnii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
